reasoning: The evidence strongly suggests global CO2 emissions will NOT decrease in 2025. Snippet 1 shows Climate TRACE data indicating cumulative 2025 emissions through November were 0.50% HIGHER than the same period in 2024. Snippet 5 notes fossil fuel emissions continue rising at ~1% annually. While snippet 8 reports China's emissions may have declined 0.3% in 2025, China alone cannot offset global trends. The IEA question specifically asks about global emissions, and the preponderance of evidence points to continued growth, albeit slower. Historical patterns show emissions rarely decrease without major disruptions like COVID.
